# tacsim's integration test targets (one per crates/tacsim/tests/*.rs), split
# across the `test` job's `tacsim-integration-N` shards in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
# `scripts/ci-tacsim-shard.sh N` runs line N as `cargo test -p tacsim --test ...`.
#
# Four shards since 2026-10-26 (cut T.0), balanced longest-first by each
# binary's mean execution time over main's green runs 40259028915, 40266288970
# and 40278097329: 14.4, 14.5, 15.9 and 15.9 min of test run per shard, 16 or
# 17 binaries each, against 57.7 min as one. The three shards before ran 11-20,
# 17 and 18-30 min, the third swinging with the runner. cost_lane joined after
# those runs and is placed at an estimated 180 s. The named #[ignore]d
# mind-hash steps follow their targets (minds_rhai and twin in shard 2,
# minds_pool in shard 1), and each shard's placement counts them.
#
# Every target must appear on exactly one line:
# crates/mush-contract-tests/tests/ci_tacsim_shards.rs fails on a missing,
# doubled or unknown target, so a new test file cannot silently go unrun.
# Rebalance from a fresh run's timings when a shard drifts far from the others
# (per-binary times: each shard log's `Running tests/<target>.rs` line and the
# `finished in` of the `test result:` line that follows it).
1: claims coop driving harness hulls landing minds_pool mining passage perception price replay s9_corridor sale sheet shipped_scale stations
2: content cost_lane deposits e7r1 e7r2 extensions minds minds_rhai moon_ports plans plumbing reflex sight twin unloading voyage weapons
3: capacity commerce composition_edges definitions deliberation drones e7c1 ephemeris knowing mill motor orders port_tick ports report reset
4: arena arena_task chart cockpit conditions core_replacement economy excursions geology lane match_lifecycle quarry resolution sites sky vehicles
